verses.text: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

segments.text: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.text: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

segments.text: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.text: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

segments.text: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.text: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

segments.text: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

segments.text: For his anger
endureth but
a moment; in his favour
is
life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy
cometh
in the morning.

notes: 30.5 his anger…: Heb. there is but a moment in his anger
30.5 for a night: Heb. in the evening

verses.text: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

segments.text: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.text: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

segments.text: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face,
and
I was troubled.

notes: 30.7 made…: Heb. settled strength for my mountain

verses.text: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

segments.text: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

verses.text: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

segments.text: What profit
is there
in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.text: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

segments.text: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

verses.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

segments.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.text: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

segments.text: To the end that
my
glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

notes: 30.12 my glory: that is, my tongue, or, my soul

headings.text: A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of David.
